objective: Find Ryedol's Lucky Pick and return it to Prospector Ryedol south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.

description: Hey, <name>. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.
They just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. I barely escaped with me life.
The site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.
Think you'd be up to helpin' me out some? One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! Could be anyone of them.
progress: Not sure what the Shadowforge were lookin' for, but they definitely had a purpose.
completion: Ye're me savior, <class>. I'm glad someone could teach those Shadowforge a lesson or two. Thanks for yer help.
